WITH session_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        s.seshkey,
        u.typelabel,
        u.seglabel,
        s.bncrate,
        s.ctrval,
        ROUND(CAST(s.bncrate * (1 - s.ctrval / 100) AS numeric), 4) AS sbra,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.bncrate) AS bounce_percentile,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.ctrval DESC) AS ctr_percentile
    FROM sessions s
    JOIN users u ON s.userel = u.userkey
),
session_classified AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE
            WHEN bounce_percentile < 0.25 AND ctr_percentile < 0.25 THEN 'High Bounce, Low CTR'
            WHEN bounce_percentile < 0.25 AND ctr_percentile >= 0.75 THEN 'High Bounce, High CTR'
            WHEN bounce_percentile >= 0.75 AND ctr_percentile < 0.25 THEN 'Low Bounce, Low CTR'
            WHEN bounce_percentile >= 0.75 AND ctr_percentile >= 0.75 THEN 'Low Bounce, High CTR'
            ELSE 'Average Performance'
        END AS performance_category
    FROM session_metrics
),

    SELECT seglabel, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
    FROM session_classified
    GROUP BY seglabel
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
)
